dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle, with the caudal terminus obscured by water depth and blur.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate grey across the dorsal plane, indicating a non-mature (juvenile or sub-adult) pigmentation stage.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse dark-pixel clusters distributed across the dorsal surface, most notably anterior to the blowhole and along the visible lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-contrast gradient transitions between the slate-grey baseline and localized darker pigmented patches.
